name: @commercetools-labs/auto-categorization
description: Rule-driven category membership for commercetools, as a Connect connector

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix common-connect install && npm --prefix product-extension install && npm --prefix rules-api install && npm --prefix category-event install && npm --prefix sweep-job install && npm --prefix merchant-center-custom-application install && npm --prefix merchant-center-custom-view install && npm --prefix tools install
scripts.build: npm --prefix common-connect run build && npm run sync:shared && npm --prefix product-extension run build && npm --prefix rules-api run build && npm --prefix category-event run build && npm --prefix sweep-job run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix product-extension run typecheck && npm --prefix rules-api run typecheck && npm --prefix category-event run typecheck && npm --prefix sweep-job run typecheck && npm --prefix merchant-center-custom-application run typecheck && npm --prefix merchant-center-custom-view run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix common-connect test && npm --prefix product-extension test && npm --prefix rules-api test && npm --prefix category-event test && npm --prefix sweep-job test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix common-connect run lint && npm --prefix product-extension run lint && npm --prefix rules-api run lint && npm --prefix category-event run lint && npm --prefix sweep-job run lint
scripts.build:mc: npm --prefix merchant-center-custom-application run build && npm --prefix merchant-center-custom-view run build
scripts.predeploy: npm run build && npm run check:shared && npm run test && npm run lint
scripts.audit: npm --prefix product-extension audit --omit=dev && npm --prefix rules-api audit --omit=dev && npm --prefix category-event audit --omit=dev && npm --prefix sweep-job audit --omit=dev
scripts.preflight: npm run predeploy && npm run audit && npm run simulate:connect
